claim.claim-text: 1. A cultivated Cucumis sativus var. sativus plant comprising an introgression fragment from a wild relative of cucumber on chromosome 6 in homozygous or heterozygous form, wherein said introgression fragment confers an increase in cucumber fruit yield and is obtainable from seeds deposited under accession number NCIMB42545 and wherein the introgression fragment on chromosome 6 is detectable by a molecular marker assay which detects at least one, preferably at least 2 or 3, of the markers selected from the group consisting of:

2. The plant according to claim 1, wherein said increase in cucumber fruit yield is phenotypically expressed as a significantly higher average number of fruits per plant (FrPP) of the plant line comprising the introgression fragment compared to the genetic control line lacking the introgression fragment when grown under the same environment and/or a significantly higher average fruit weight per plant (GrPP) of the plant line comprising the introgression fragment compared to the genetic control line lacking the introgression fragment when grown under the same environment.

3. The plant according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the introgression fragment comprises a Quantitative Trait Locus QTL6.1 conferring an increase in cucumber fruit yield, and wherein said QTL6.1 is located in between SNP_27 in SEQ ID NO: 27 and SNP_40 in SEQ ID NO: 40.

4. The plant according to any one of the preceding claims, further comprising an introgression fragment on chromosome 2, wherein the introgression fragment on chromosome 2 is detectable by a molecular marker assay which detects at least one, preferably at least 2 or 3, of the markers selected from the group consisting of:
5. The plant according to claim 4, wherein the introgression fragment on chromosome 2 is obtainable from seeds deposited under accession number NCIMB42545.
6. The plant according to claim 5, wherein both introgression fragments are in heterozygous form.

7. The plant according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the introgression fragment on chromosome 2 comprises a cucumber fruit yield increasing Quantitative Trait Locus (QTL2.1), which is located physically in the region starting at 5.0 Mb and ending at 11.0 Mb of chromosome 2 and wherein the introgression fragment on chromosome 6 comprises a cucumber fruit yield increasing Quantitative Trait Locus (QTL6.1) which is located physically in the region starting at 25.0 Mb and ending at 29.0 Mb of chromosome 6.
8. The plant according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein one or both introgression fragments are in homozygous form.
9. The plant according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the plant is of one of the following cucumber types: slicing cucumber, long cucumber, European greenhouse cucumber.
10. The plant according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the plant is a single cross F1 hybrid or an inbred line.
11. The plant according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the plant produces seedless fruits without pollination.

12. The plant according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein said introgression fragment on chromosome 2 and/or 6 is the fragment as found on chromosome 2 and/or 6 in seeds deposited under accession number NCIMB42545, or a smaller fragment thereof, which smaller fragment confers an increase in cucumber fruit yield.
13. Seeds from which a plant according to any one of the preceding claims can be grown.
